title: Ninapenda podikasti ya Ebinpu, na inanipa mtazamo sikuwa na

text.I like this podcast by a person called E: Ninapenda podikasti hii ya mtu anayeitwa Ebinpu.
text.She is a woman in her mid-30s from Kansa: Yeye ni mwanamke katika 30 kutoka Kansai, na hasa anatoa ushauri kuhusu mapenzi na kuwinda ndoa, na ninaposikiliza, huwaza, "Mtu huyu ni mwerevu."
text.Also, I get to know a view I didn't have: Pia, ninapata kujua mtazamo ambao sikuwa nao, kama, "Loo, wanawake wazima wanafikiria hivyo," na inahisi kama ulimwengu wangu unakua zaidi.
text.Her Kansai dialect also feels nice to li: Lahaja yake ya Kikansai pia anahisi vizuri kuisikiliza.
text.It's not the kind of funny that makes yo: Sio aina ya kuchekesha inayokufanya ucheke sana, lakini zaidi kama, "Naona," na ninajifunza kitu.
text.Music works better than a podcast when I: Muziki wa hufanya kazi vizuri zaidi kuliko podikasti ninapofanya jambo
text.I want to add comments to my articles wh: Nataka kuongeza maoni kwenye makala zangu nipatapo muda
